business_problem: C Spire support teams were spending too much time manually triaging inbound emails, identifying affected customers and locations, and deciding whether the issue represented an outage.
solution_summary: C Spire support teams were spending too much time manually triaging inbound emails, identifying affected customers and locations, and deciding whether the issue represented an outage. C Spire implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, AI Agents, and Knowledge Base. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; AI Agents run AI-driven triage and response tasks; Knowledge Base stores reusable support content. The stack also connected email so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by AI Agents, and uses context from Knowledge Base and email before ServiceNow AI Platform routes or fulfills the work. Updates then flow back to agents, account teams, or customers through the same connected experience.
